title: automorphic-eisenstein-residue widget params
description: Bespoke Eisenstein-residue scrubber for the automorphic-forms-adelic topic. A slider over the spectral parameter s drives an SVG that shows the constant term of an Eisenstein series along the line Re(s) = sigma, exposing the simple pole at s = 1 that produces the residual spectrum. The single-slider-plus-pole-plot residue-illustration layout is specific to spectral decomposition and does not fit parametric-plot.
